title: 🎙️ Grok finally speaks.. a new voice mode for instant conversations!
body: 🎙️ Grok finally speaks.. a new voice mode for instant conversations!
xAI began rolling out a new voice mode for the Grok chatbot, letting users talk to it by voice in instant conversations, instead of typing, on computers and phones running iOS and Android.

The voice mode is reaching users in batches and at different times depending on the platform, and it relies on a new voice system called Grok Voice Think Fast 2.0, which the company says is better than its previous voice system, and that it beats two competing services in speech-to-text accuracy.

The voice mode means talking to AI has become closer to a real call: you speak and it answers you instantly, without waiting to type questions and read answers, a direction all major chatbots are following to make interaction faster and more natural.

The company also made the same voice technology available to developers through the Fal platform, so they can build fast-responding voice agents and voice-based apps with it, in a step that expands the use of voice beyond the Grok chatbot itself to other apps.

The rollout comes at a time when AI companies are competing over who speaks best, not who writes best, as voice has become an entirely new interface: an assistant that understands you from your tone and answers you in the same moment.

Simply put: Grok can now talk and listen, with a new voice system that is faster and more accurate, and developers can also build voice agents with the same technology; do you prefer talking to AI by voice, or is typing more precise and calmer?
Has voice become the future of dealing with AI, or will typing stay first?
